experiment.question: Can the exact pinned Shiu source, bundled FlyWire-v630 inputs and original dependency environment be materialized and smoke-checked without modifying MUSCA runtime or upstream scientific parameters?
experiment.hypothesis: The pinned upstream source and bundled v630 inputs can be materialized in an isolated strict environment derived from environment_full.yml, with complete provenance and without source/data mutation.
experiment.falsifier: The exact source/data cannot be materialized or read under the declared strict lineage without silent dependency substitution, source/data mutation or an unrecorded provenance gap.
experiment.model: R00 environment/data smoke for the unmodified upstream Brian2 model; no 30-trial R01 experiment
experiment.task: Verify exact source state and hashes, solve the original full environment, import dependencies, load v630 inputs and optionally construct the model once under a bounded resource check
fixed_conditions: environment_full.yml is attempted before any compatibility environment
exact-commit source may be retrieved through GitHub codeload only when key file Git blob IDs match the pinned commit
metrics: failure class and stderr when blocked
experiment.compute_budget: Read-only preflight first. Strict materialization uses isolated E:\MUSCA_RESEARCH storage; preserve failure instead of silently substituting a modern environment.
experiment.analysis_plan: Classify each gate independently: governance, source pin, host tooling, storage, strict environment, data load and optional model construction. Preserve the first blocking condition and all provenance receipts. Do not treat compatibility execution as strict R00.
experiment.success_criterion: Exact upstream commit observed; required files hashed locally; original/full environment solved and imports succeed; v630 inputs load; no source/data/scientific-parameter mutation; resource use remains within the declared operational budget.
confounds: environment_full.yml contains old Windows-specific conda build pins
preregistration host initially lacked a solver; portable micromamba 2.9.0 was later materialized project-locally with SHA-256 receipt
pre-existing Python 3.10 is not required if a strict conda-compatible solver can materialize it
successful environment/data materialization does not reproduce a published biological result
dataset licensing and game-commercial rights remain separate from local reproduction engineering

non_claims: This manifest does not authorize installation, download or simulation execution.
This is not R01 and does not execute the 30-trial sugar experiment.
This is not a topology-superiority or game-value experiment.
